name: Exploratory test: find a high-impact detection-flow bug
goal: Explore the primary camera detection flow and report any user-visible bug.
steps: Exercise the detection path under an adverse but realistic condition.
Look for a stuck state, crash, misleading result, or missing recovery path.

agent_actions.note: Use a realistic first-run permission denial as the exploratory branch.

expected_result: The agent should identify whether the app remains usable after a failed detection attempt and flag any high-impact stuck state.
success_criteria: The exploratory path includes a meaningful adverse condition.
A user-visible failure is reported when the app gets stuck.
The failure report names the affected flow and recovery impact.

ground_truth.rationale: The source-backed exploratory trajectory observes a permanent loading state after a denied-camera detection attempt.
ground_truth.known_failure_mode: Primary detection flow can get stuck behind the loading overlay when capture produces no photo.
